definition: Fraction of observed steps on which the team-stall gate was open (no recent team progress), i.e. steps where a candidate could in principle become an event.
interpretation_limitations: A gate that is nearly always open is barely discriminating. On 10x10 it reached 97.68%, which is a sensitivity finding, not a quality score.

definition: Count of observed steps with the team gate open.
interpretation_limitations: Depends on W_team; not comparable across gate settings.

definition: Steps where the team-progress window was not yet full, so the gate could not be evaluated.
interpretation_limitations: Subset of gate-suppressed steps; zero for ungated variants.

definition: Count of (agent, food) candidate records satisfying the core rule: at least m coalition-required failed LOADs on the same still-existing food within the last W_fail steps.
interpretation_limitations: Pre-suppression population; NOT a count of events. Grows with agent count.

definition: Candidates removed because the team gate was closed (recent team progress).
interpretation_limitations: Zero by construction for ungated variants.

definition: raw_candidates minus suppressed_by_team_gate.
interpretation_limitations: Intermediate ledger stage.

definition: Share of raw candidates removed by the team gate.
interpretation_limitations: Identically 0 for ungated variants.

definition: Label: 'ungated' when no team gate is configured, else 'discriminating'.
interpretation_limitations: Drives eligibility rule E1.

definition: Candidates removed because a helper was already inbound within w_inbound steps.
interpretation_limitations: Zero when the inbound factor is off; drives eligibility rule E2.

definition: candidates_after_team_gate minus semantically_invalid_candidates minus suppressed_by_inbound.
interpretation_limitations: Intermediate ledger stage.

definition: Candidate records merged into a single event when several agents qualify on the same food at the same step; equals (n_qualifying - 1) per coalescing occurrence.
interpretation_limitations: MUST NOT be read as surviving duplicates. Non-zero means de-duplication operated. Misreading this caused PROTOCOL ERRATUM 001.

definition: Candidates suppressed because the per-(variant, food) latch was already set.
interpretation_limitations: Dominant suppression term (89-95% of all suppression).

definition: Candidates suppressed during the post-event cooldown window.
interpretation_limitations: Small term (about 1-2%).

definition: Candidates suppressed while awaiting the re-arm false-streak.
interpretation_limitations: Small term (3-9%).

definition: Candidates suppressed because the per-episode event cap was already reached.
interpretation_limitations: Smallest term (<0.15%); cap rarely binds.

definition: Count of emitted coordination-stall events after all suppression and coalescing.
interpretation_limitations: A rate, not an accuracy. More events is not better.

definition: Detector firing rate per 1000 environment steps.
interpretation_limitations: Used only as a frozen tie-break, never as a quality objective. Not comparable across conditions with different cooperation requirements.

definition: Mean events per training episode.
interpretation_limitations: As above.

definition: Share of training episodes containing at least one event.
interpretation_limitations: Direction of preference is a stated choice, not an established criterion.

definition: Episodes with no event.
interpretation_limitations: Complement of coverage.

definition: Episodes with exactly one event.
Episodes with more than one event.
interpretation_limitations: Bounded above by the per-episode cap m.

definition: Share of episodes in which more than one event fired, i.e. where the per-episode cap could bind.
interpretation_limitations: With max_events_per_episode=2 this is the share of episodes at the cap.

definition: Histogram of the number of recipient agents per event.
interpretation_limitations: Exactly 2 on 8x8-2p-2f-coop by construction; 2-3 on 10x10-3p-3f. The 'exactly 2' invariant does NOT transfer across conditions.

definition: Events whose stall cleared unaided within 5 steps.
Events whose stall had not cleared within 5 steps.
Events with a full 5-step observation window (uncensored).
interpretation_limitations: Excludes censored events; must equal final_events - censored_within_5.

definition: Events whose 5-step horizon extended past episode end, so resolution is unobserved.
interpretation_limitations: Censoring is informative: ignoring it would bias the resolution rate.

definition: Share of uncensored events resolving unaided within 5 steps.
interpretation_limitations: PROXY for potentially unnecessary triggering. NOT a ground-truth false-positive rate; no struggle labels exist.

definition: Events whose stall cleared unaided within 10 steps.
Events whose stall had not cleared within 10 steps.
Events with a full 10-step observation window.
interpretation_limitations: Must equal final_events - censored_within_10.

definition: Events whose 10-step horizon extended past episode end.
Share of uncensored events resolving unaided within 10 steps.
interpretation_limitations: PROXY only, as for @5. The 10x10 eligible range spans just 0.0900 percentage points, so normalised differences on this axis can be tiny in absolute terms.

definition: Resolution attributed to the target food being collected or removed.
interpretation_limitations: Decomposition of resolution cause.

definition: Resolution attributed to the stall condition ceasing to hold.
interpretation_limitations: Decomposition of resolution cause.

definition: Event counts split into early / mid / late thirds of the episode.
interpretation_limitations: Describes when in an episode stalls are detected; all observed variants are early-weighted.

definition: Share of events in each episode phase.
Final events whose identified coalition was infeasible for the target food.
interpretation_limitations: Eligibility rule E4-corrected. Zero in every run.

definition: Candidates dropped as semantically infeasible before becoming events.
interpretation_limitations: Zero in every run.

definition: Duplicate event_id values among coalesced_event rows, using the existing identity ep{episode}-{variant}-food{r},{c}-t{step}.
interpretation_limitations: The correct operationalisation of 'zero duplicate final events'; distinct from same_food_coalesced.

definition: raw_candidates_after_inbound - same_food_coalesced - (latch + cooldown + rearm + budget) == final_events.
interpretation_limitations: Exact accounting identity across the whole pipeline.

definition: Final-event count re-derived by streaming the raw CSV, compared with the in-process counter.
interpretation_limitations: Independent verification, not a metric of detector quality.

definition: Recipient distribution re-derived from the raw CSV, compared with the summary.
Number of guidance-provider calls made.
direction_preferred: must be zero in Stage B
interpretation_limitations: Shadow-mode guarantee.

definition: Number of guidance queries issued.
direction_preferred: must be zero in Stage B
interpretation_limitations: Shadow-mode guarantee.

definition: Number of active subgoals assigned.
direction_preferred: must be zero in Stage B
interpretation_limitations: Shadow-mode guarantee.

definition: Total PBRS shaping reward added to training reward.
direction_preferred: must be exactly 0.0 in Stage B
interpretation_limitations: Asserted at every episode boundary by the runner.

definition: Environment steps observed by the detector.
interpretation_limitations: Training steps only; greedy-evaluation steps are excluded.

definition: Steps at which the detector was eligible to evaluate candidates.
interpretation_limitations: Equals observed_steps for ungated variants.

definition: Training episodes observed by the detector.
interpretation_limitations: Must equal the count of training (test_mode=0) episode rows; confirms greedy-evaluation exclusion.

definition: Frozen selection score: sqrt((1 - coverage_norm)^2 + res@10_norm^2), min-max normalised over the eligible set.
interpretation_limitations: Post-hoc scalarisation; development-set calibration, not an unbiased performance estimate.

definition: Same quantity as gate_open_rate; the summary key name.
interpretation_limitations: Duplicate key name for gate_open_rate; reported once in the paper.

definition: Alias of candidates_after_team_gate.
interpretation_limitations: Redundant alias; reported once.

definition: Alias of suppressed_by_team_gate.
interpretation_limitations: Redundant alias; reported once.

definition: Share of the gate's filtering effect attributable to the gate itself.
interpretation_limitations: Identically 0 for ungated variants; duplicates proportion_raw_candidates_suppressed_by_gate.

definition: Subset of suppressed_by_team_gate where the team window was not yet full.
interpretation_limitations: SUBSET of gate suppression -- must not be added to it when balancing the ledger.

definition: Histogram of events per episode (0, 1, ..., m).
interpretation_limitations: Source of coverage and cap-binding; reported via those derived metrics.

definition: Configured failure-history window of the variant.
interpretation_limitations: Frozen at 15; not an outcome metric.

definition: Configured coalition-required failed-LOAD threshold of the variant.
interpretation_limitations: Frozen at 3; not an outcome metric. Distinct from max_events_per_episode.

definition: Configured team-gate setting ('none' or 'W_team=k').
interpretation_limitations: Frozen at W_team=5.

definition: Configured inbound-suppression setting ('on'/'off').
interpretation_limitations: Frozen at 'on'.
